hypotheses.justification: The unfolding lemma requires only hD', not hD'm. The remaining integrands agree at every x by the existing hterm argument. Replace setIntegral_congr_fun hD'm with MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ...), applied under ν.restrict D'. This also works for empty or nonmeasurable D'.

This instance is needed only when invoking ideleNorm_mul_principal. Prove that step locally with MeasurableSpace (AdeleRing (𝓞 F) F) := borel _ and BorelSpace := ⟨rfl⟩. Its conclusion, ideleNorm, schwartzBruhat, and ThetaSum do not depend on the measurable structure on the adele ring. The integration measure and measurable structure on its units remain unchanged, so the rest of the proof works without this hypothesis, with no exceptional cases.
